summary: Replace the native Bare Hands click experiment with a modular webcam-only Jarvis interaction stack: stable tracking, gesture recognition, primary/secondary pinch intent, semantic target understanding, one-hand move/two-hand constrained resize, tools/settings, calibration, tutorial, and diagnostics.
locked_constraints: V1 uses standard webcams and targets Jarvis UI only.
MediaPipe remains the V1 default tracker but must sit behind an interchangeable tracker contract.
No permanent pointer; target feedback appears only during interaction intent and is configurable.
Lifecycle is OFF/SLEEP/ACTIVE with C-pose wake and 30s no-hand return to SLEEP.
Primary pinch is thumb-index; secondary/right-click pinch is thumb-middle.
BODY interacts with content; only frame edges/corners are manipulation zones.
One manipulation-zone capture moves the frame; two compatible zone captures on the same frame resize with per-zone axis constraints.
Two hands may manipulate different objects independently.
Captures latch until release; no axis inversion; clamp at minimum size; RESIZE->MOVE must not jump.
Calibration is optional, explicit, statistical/threshold-based, partially successful per function, and does not auto-learn continuously.
Calibration stores derived parameters only by default and retains no raw image/video.
Native implementation must remain clean-room with respect to pinned AGPL upstream Barehands.
planning_blockers: Workspace Task Type vocabulary is not exposed; Slice 00 must assign valid existing Task Types before implementation dispatch.
Exact current Control Center/Constellation component contracts and voice-command registration points must be freshness-audited by Slice 00 before dependent Slices are dispatched.
